figurative_meaning_en: To put someone in an awkward or embarrassing position
similar_in_english: To put someone on the spot
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীকে ল্যাং মেরে বেকায়দায় ফেলল।
মিটিং-এ তার বস তাকে ল্যাং মেরে অস্বস্তিতে ফেলে দিলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He put his rival in an awkward position by tripping him up.
In the meeting, his boss put him on the spot, leaving him embarrassed.
note: This idiom draws from physical discomfort to metaphorically describe social awkwardness in Bengali vernacular.
